caveat: Formative evaluation only; the four principles are declared emergent and untested, and the pilot is one Australian science faculty.
title: Co-Designing For Integrity: A Student Partnership Approach to Developing Ethical AI Literacy Resources in Higher Education
venue: Journal of University Teaching and Learning Practice
why: DBR plus a student-staff partnership yielding four testable design principles for ethical AI literacy, and honest that an opt-in module barely reached the students it was for. Directly usable in the AI and Professional Criticality papers.
